notes: #8 Merian view dated 1650 (Topographia Bohemiae, Moraviae et Silesiae); Commons says 1642, and the colored copy #7 is captioned ‘Breslau im Jahre 1650’. #4 is the 1594 printing of B&H vol. 4, dated to vol. 4’s first publication, 1588. #17 inscription reads roughly ‘Breslau. Der Hafen … Oderbrücke 1835’; #18 is a photo reproduction of the same drawing. #20 chosen over #24 (same photochrom with altered colors). Skipped: #16 vue d’optique looks fanciful and is dated only 1742–1801; #27 is an older engraving reprinted in a 1929 book; #28 NARA aerial has only a guessed date (about 1920); #30 is a reprint of an old engraving in a 1924 book. P6 photo is heavily HDR-processed; a better modern view of the Market Square or Ostrów Tumski would help if available.
